card.name: Event announcements before RSVP or refreshments
card.fires_on: Punctuation and small words in university event or seminar announcements, right after the place, time or invitation details. It fires where a line like 'Lunch will be provided' or 'All are invited' could come next.

modes.label: After venue line
modes.description: The gap or full stop just after a room, building or location in a seminar listing.
modes.example: Wednesday, October 17, 2012 365 S. Mudd, Salvatori Room<< >>Environmental Science and Engineering Seminar The plumbing

modes.label: Food and invitation sentences
modes.description: Full stops or small words inside sentences about lunch, refreshments, prizes or who is invited.
modes.example: All are invited to the event, which is sponsored by the Latin American Campus Association<<.>> Light refreshments will be available.

card.writes: It pushes toward invitation words such as RSVP, invite, join and come.
card.plain: It marks the spot in a campus event notice where an invitation or RSVP line is likely to come next.
